def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The border bars indicate the line direction. Horizontal bars at the
    # top/bottom mean that interior markers extend vertically toward bottom.
    edge_color = grid[0][next(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v != grid[0][0])]
    base = grid[0][0]
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != base and grid[r][c] != edge_color
             and (r, c) not in [(0, c) for c in range(w)]
             and r != h - 1]
    for r, c, color in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
        for rr in range(r + 1, h - 1):
            if grid[rr][c] == base:
                out[rr][c] = color
    return out
